PostToolUse.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.py) b=$(basename "$f" .py); t=$(find . -name "test_$b.py" -not -path "*/.git/*" 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -n "$t" ]; then cd "$(dirname "$t")" && python3 -m pytest "$(basename "$t")" -q --tb=line -rfE 2>&1 | tail -15; else echo "no test_$b.py found; gate skipped"; fi ;; *) : ;; esac
